name: Camble Release
description: Executable Camble release, Android and Kubernetes operations.

actions.label: Collect release refs
actions.description: Resolve exact source/target refs, per-service SHAs and stale/current state for Preprod or Prod.

actions.label: Promote refs
actions.description: Promote selected services from dev to tags/* or from tags/* to prod/* with guarded ref updates.
actions.confirm: Apply the exact Camble ref promotion plan?

actions.label: Inspect version
actions.description: Read version and Android build number from application3 dev.

actions.label: Apply version
actions.description: Dispatch version-apply.yml against the verified application3 dev SHA.
actions.confirm: Dispatch the Camble version workflow with these exact values?

actions.label: Build application
actions.description: Resolve current application3/backend dev SHAs on the selected or next free compatible agent and build signed APK/AAB artifacts.
actions.confirm: Build signed Camble Android artifacts from the current application3/backend dev refs on this agent?

actions.label: Test
actions.description: Run fail-closed Camble browser and Android checks against an exact environment and immutable source revisions.
actions.confirm: Build any selected Android artifact and run the selected Camble tests on this agent?

actions.label: Observe cluster
actions.description: Verify full source SHAs and running-pod imageID digests for Camble deployments in the camee namespace.

actions.label: Collect cluster logs
actions.description: Collect bounded recent logs from all Camble deployment pods in the camee namespace for live incident diagnosis.

actions.label: Deploy cluster services
actions.description: Create immutable full-SHA provenance tags, lease-update Devtron branches and verify deployment/pod digests with safe branch recovery.
actions.confirm: Create immutable full-SHA Camble provenance tags, lease-update deployment branches and verify exact rollout digests?
